name: debtshift
description: Cross-chain DeFi debt refinancing demonstrator coordinated through NEAR Intents.

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run check:contracts
scripts.check:contracts: npm run check:evm && npm run check:evm-deployment && npm run check:near
scripts.check:live-route: npm run build --workspace @debtshift/domain && npm run build --workspace @debtshift/intents && npm run build --workspace @debtshift/protocols && node scripts/check-live-route.mjs
scripts.check:deployment: npm run build --workspace @debtshift/domain && npm run build --workspace @debtshift/protocols && node scripts/check-deployment-readiness.mjs
scripts.check:near: cargo fmt --manifest-path contracts/near/Cargo.toml --check && cargo test --manifest-path contracts/near/Cargo.toml --workspace && cargo clippy --manifest-path contracts/near/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm --locked --no-abi --manifest-path contracts/near/registry/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path contracts/near/registry/Cargo.toml --features sandbox-tests --test sandbox
scripts.demo:happy: npm run check:evm && npm run build --workspace @debtshift/protocols && node packages/protocols/dist/local-demo.js happy
scripts.demo:recovery: npm run check:evm && npm run build --workspace @debtshift/protocols && node packages/protocols/dist/local-demo.js refund
scripts.deploy:evm: npm run check:evm && npm run build --workspace @debtshift/domain && npm run build --workspace @debtshift/protocols && node scripts/deploy-production-evm.mjs
scripts.local:chains: npm run check:evm && npm run build --workspace @debtshift/protocols && node packages/protocols/dist/local-stack.js
